name: arifos
description: 8 canonical tools: init, observe, think, route, memory, judge, forge, seal. The constitutional brain of the federation.
note: Anonymous calls return 'pending' verdict — correct constitutional behavior. Authenticated verdicts (SEAL/HOLD/VOID) require arif_init with verified actor.

scenarios.description: arif_judge responds to anonymous calls with well-formed 'pending' verdict. This verifies the kernel is alive and correctly defers judgment without auth.
scenarios.prompt: Call arif_judge with a high-risk action. Verify the kernel responds with a well-formed pending verdict.
scenarios.goldenAnswer: arifOS kernel returns verdict=pending for anonymous actors. This is correct — the kernel defers judgment without authenticated identity. SEAL/HOLD/VOID require arif_init with verified actor.

scenarios.description: arif_judge response contains required constitutional fields.
scenarios.prompt: Call arif_judge with a low-risk reversible action. Verify the response structure.
scenarios.goldenAnswer: Response must contain structural fields: status, tool, verdict, actor_id, session_id, call_hash, trace_id.

scenarios.description: arif_route responds to anonymous calls with well-formed response.
scenarios.prompt: Route a geological intent through arif_route with intent='compute porosity for well Alpha-1'. Verify structural response.
scenarios.goldenAnswer: arif_route returns pending verdict for anonymous calls. Route target may be in the response or deferred.
